name: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime
description: Evergreen WebView2 Runtime used by applications that embed Edge web content.

detection.value: $keys = @('HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\EdgeUpdate\Clients\{F3017226-FE2A-4295-8BDF-00C3A9A7E4C5}', 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\EdgeUpdate\Clients\{F3017226-FE2A-4295-8BDF-00C3A9A7E4C5}'); $found = $false; foreach ($key in $keys) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $key) { $pv = (Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $key -Name pv -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).pv; if ($pv -and $pv -ne '0.0.0.0') { $found = $true; break } } }; if ($found) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }
